evidence: Water vapor and Hf [N(C 2H5)CH3]4 (tetrakis ethylmethylamino-hafnium) were used as precursors. These were administered for 0.5 and 2 s, respectively. A N 2 purge was performed for 35 s before the introduction of each precursor. ALD was performed for 88 cycles at 350 °C followed by annealing at 550 °C in Ar ambient gas for 30 min.
